transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because I barely sleep right anymore. I just... I lie there hearing the rain, or thinking about the bluff giving way. And when I finally do pass out, I just wake up sweaty from... from these dreams. Then I just show up to my shifts at the call center feeling like I never even slept.
When you mentioned the bluff giving way, can you tell me more about that? Was this something you experienced personally or witnessed?
Yeah, I... I was there. I was on the trail when it collapsed. I got trapped for a bit. Um... that was about four months ago. It's just been happening since then.
Since the bluff collapse, have you found yourself reliving the experience, like having flashbacks or feeling as though the event is happening again?

Um... yeah, I guess. Sometimes stuff just... pops in my head out of nowhere. Like... I'll hear the sound of the rocks sliding, or... or I'll feel like my leg is stuck under me again. And just for a minute, I'm... I'm back on that trail, instead of sitting at my desk with my headset on. So... yeah. It happens.
Since the incident on the trail, have you found yourself avoiding places, people, or activities that remind you of what happened?

Um... yeah. I guess so. I just... I don't go near the coast trails anymore. Haven't been back. And... I kind of ignore texts from the guys I used to hike with. Just... even thinking about talking to them about going back out there, it just makes my chest feel all tight. So I just... don't.
